items.summary: Swati Chaudhary created history by winning a silver medal, securing India's first-ever W1 archery medal at the Asian Para Games.

items.title: Suvarna Raj Clinches Women's F54 Discus Gold at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Suvarna Raj from Greater Noida secured the gold medal in the women's F54 discus event at the Asian Para Games 2026 with four throws exceeding the 15-metre mark.

items.title: Simran Secures Second Gold Medal with Games Record at Asian Para Games
items.summary: Indian athlete Simran won the gold medal in the women's 100m T12 event with a new Games record at the Asian Para Games. She had previously won the 200m gold medal with a Games record on October 20.

items.title: Dilip Gavit Wins Gold in Men's 100m T47 at Asian Para Games
items.summary: Dilip Gavit clocked 10.69 seconds to win the gold medal in the men's 100m T47 event at the Asian Para Games. Morssinganakath secured the silver medal with a timing of 10.72 seconds, securing a gold-silver finish for India.

items.title: President Murmu Confers National Exhibition of Art Awards
items.summary: President Murmu presented the National Exhibition of Art Awards.

items.title: Sonia Gandhi Announces Memoir 'Belonging: A Journey of Love'
items.summary: Sonia Gandhi introduced the first look of her upcoming book titled 'Belonging: A Journey of Love'.

items.title: Sheetal Wins Double Gold in Archery at Asian Para Games 2026 as India Reaches 88 Medals
items.summary: Sheetal secured double gold in archery at the Asian Para Games 2026 as India raised its overall tally to 88 medals, including 21 gold, 26 silver, and 41 bronze. Para-athletics was the biggest contributor with 52 medals, including 18 gold.

items.title: RBI Transfers Record ₹2.87 Lakh Crore Surplus to Central Government
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India transferred a record surplus of ₹2.87 lakh crore to the Central Government. Earnings from foreign assets and reserve management highlight the RBI's expanding role in supporting national finances.

items.title: Mona Agarwal Wins Second Gold with World Record at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Mona Agarwal won her second gold medal with a world record at the Asian Para Games 2026 in the women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 event scoring 250.0. Lekhara secured the silver medal in the same event with a score of 249.6 points.

items.title: Sandeep and Haney Set World Records to Win Gold at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Sandeep and Haney won gold medals with world records at the Asian Para Games 2026. India's Nimisha Chakkungalparambil and Parmod Bijarnia earned silver medals in the women's long jump T47 and men's 1500m T46 events respectively.

items.title: India Secures Gold in Para Recurve Men’s Doubles Archery at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: India won the gold medal in para recurve men’s doubles archery at the Asian Para Games 2026 by defeating China 5-1 on set points in the final.

items.title: Anjanaben Bumbadiya Wins Gold and Jayanti Behera Silver in Women’s 400m T47 at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Anjanaben Bumbadiya won gold in the women’s 400m T47 race at the Asian Para Games 2026 with a time of 59.97 seconds, making her the sole athlete to finish under one minute. Jayanti Behera claimed the silver medal in the same event.

items.title: India and Poland Set $12 Billion Bilateral Trade Target for 2030
items.summary: India and Poland have set a goal to reach a bilateral trade target of $12 billion by the year 2030.

items.title: United States to Host Inaugural Women’s Club World Cup
items.summary: The United States has been selected as the host country for the inaugural edition of the Women’s Club World Cup.

items.title: India Advocates for UNSC Reforms at United Nations
items.summary: India’s Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Harish Parvathaneni, stressed the need for United Nations Security Council reforms to address global peace effectively.

items.title: India's Medal Tally Crosses 100 at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Indian para-athletes crossed the 100-medal milestone at the Asian Para Games 2026. India previously placed fifth in the 2023 Asian Para Games with a total of 111 medals.

items.title: Nitesh Kumar and Naveen Sivakumar Win Badminton Gold at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Nitesh Kumar and Naveen Sivakumar won gold medals in badminton at the Asian Para Games 2026, defeating Pramod Bhagat and Indonesia's Fredy Setiawan respectively. Thulasimathi and Nitya secured silver medals for India.

items.title: USA to Host FIFA Women's Club World Cup in 2028
items.summary: FIFA announced that the United States will host the inaugural women's football Club World Cup in 2028.

items.title: Sheetal Bags Second Successive Gold in Women's Compound Archery at Asian Para Games 2026
items.summary: Sheetal won her second consecutive gold medal in women's compound archery at the Asian Para Games 2026, taking her overall tally to three medals at the Games. She had previously secured a silver medal in women's doubles alongside Payal Nag of Odisha.

items.title: Cabinet Secretary had copied acknowledgement sent to letters by two ECs to CEC for ‘information’: RTI reply
items.summary: Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi wrote to Cabinet Secretary T.V. Somanathan on July 29 regarding the working of Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Maneesh Garg

items.title: BJP President Nitin Nabin on a three-day visit to Jharkhand from October 23
items.summary: During his visit, Mr.Nabin will address the party workers and leaders at the inaugural session of the Jharkhand BJP State Working Committee meeting on October 24

items.title: Bihar Council elections today; Patna Graduates’ seat in focus as JD(U) faces internal tussle
items.summary: The seat, from which party MLC Neeraj Kumar is seeking a fourth consecutive term, has become the centre of attention after JD(U)’s Mokama MLA Anant Singh declared support for Jan Suraaj Party candidate Anuj Kumar Singh

items.title: UDF govt. shielding Pinarayi Vijayan in CMRL-Exalogic payoff, hawala cases: P.K. Krishnadas
items.summary: The recent Supreme Court verdict has exposed the alleged understanding between the Congress and the CPI(M) in corruption cases, alleges BJP leader

items.title: CM Satheesan offers to host Raihan Vadra's exhibition in Keralam
items.summary: Raihan Vadra said the Bikaner House administration in Delhi pulled down many of his pictures of the protests at his solo exhibition, 'No Idea Is Final'

items.title: POCSO survivor cannot be denied compensation solely due to absence of injury marks: Allahabad HC
items.summary: The case relates to an FIR registered at Sarojini Nagar police station in Lucknow on December 7, 2022. A chargesheet in this connection was filed on January 13, 2023.

items.title: What are the powers and functions of Special Executive Magistrates? | Explained
items.summary: State governments appoint Special Executive Magistrates for specific areas or purposes and give them the powers exercised by the Executive Magistrates under the BNSS, 2023

items.title: How India thwarted Pakistan’s bid to steal crucial defence data
items.summary: Officers of the Counter Intelligence Cell of Andhra Pradesh, intrigued by a slew of messaging patterns across various social media platforms, busted a major digital honey-trap racket, including the Indian conduits, whose motive was to leak sensitive defence details, specifically Naval intelligence, to the neighbouring country’s Inter-Services Intelligence, writes Sumit Bhattacharjee

items.title: Indian killed as Houthis attack Saudi Arabia’s Dammam airport
items.summary: Separately, the Houthis (Ansar Allah) claimed that Saudi Arabia had attacked a yacht carrying Indians in the Red Sea, adding that they were conducting rescue operations

items.title: Estonia on the edge as Russia-NATO tensions rise
items.summary: The NATO member is overhauling its military strategy, moving troops closer to the border and investing in long-range arms as Russia is carrying out grey-zone tactics in NATO’s eastern flank; the country’s defence spending is set to rise by 42% in 2026, reaching €2.4 billion, or around 5.4% of its GDP; the U.K. has maintained some 1,200 troops in Estonia as part of NATO’s forward defence

items.title: When mob takes law into its own hands: another man lynched in Keralam’s Palakkad
items.summary: The brutal lynching of an aurally challenged, unidentified man near the Moolathara dam in Keralam’s Palakkad has once again shaken the conscience of society. Abdul Latheef Naha speaks to investigators, psychiatrists and forensic experts to understand how did a homeless man become the target of a group that took it upon itself to punish him and such incidents are recurring.

items.title: Face-off with China continues at multiple locations along Arunachal border: ITBP D-G
items.summary: ITBP chief says drones are the future of warfare, warning that India cannot face China with traditional weapons alone; says underground shelters are a priority in the new style of border warfare

items.title: SEBI cautions investors against fraudulent stock-tip WhatsApp groups
items.summary: “To make these calls look credible, certain members, acting in concert with the operators, post false claims of profit and praise the 'expert'. This practice, known as astroturfing, creates a false impression of genuine support and induces unsuspecting investors to act on the call,” says SEBI

items.title: Congress MLAs burn Punjab CM effigy over poor law-and-order following anti-drugs crusaders murder
items.summary: “It is the voice of the entire Punjab that law and order has completely ended in Punjab,” says Partap Singh Bajwa

items.title: Use of Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay’s deep fake videos to collect money: Rajasthan youth moves Madras High Court seeking bail
items.summary: Justice N. Ramesh will hear on Friday the bail plea made by J. Shyabu Khan of Boontoli village in Alwar district

items.title: Cambridge Analytica, Facebook’s ‘friend sharing’ feature, and $25 billion penalty | Explained
items.summary: What was Facebook’s controversial ‘friend sharing’ feature? What is the Cambridge Analytica scandal? How did Facebook respond to the controversy? What was the New Mexico court’s verdict? What was Meta’s response?

items.title: Trump says Starshield restored in Ukraine, declines to say if he contacted Musk
items.summary: Musk had previously said that "any limits on speed or usage" of Starshield systems — which are operated by his SpaceX company — were "decided by the U.S. military and ultimately POTUS," referring to Trump.

items.title: India Secures First Asian Table Tennis Mixed Doubles Medal in 72 Years
items.summary: India achieved a historic feat by winning its first mixed doubles medal at the Asian Table Tennis Championship in 72 years. The Indian duo won the deciding game to secure the landmark victory.

items.title: Pankaj Advani Wins 29th World Title at World Billiards Championship
items.summary: Cue sports icon Pankaj Advani won his 29th world title at the World Billiards Championship. The 41-year-old was the only Indian player to reach the last-four stage before claiming the title.

items.title: Assam Government to Present 1st Bhupen Hazarika National Award to Usha Mangeshkar
items.summary: The Assam government announced that singer Usha Mangeshkar will be presented with the 1st Bhupen Hazarika National Award. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will present the award at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on November 29.

items.title: Madhya Pradesh Receives Over ₹15,400 Crore Investment Proposals at Semiconductor Summit
items.summary: Madhya Pradesh received investment proposals of over ₹15,400 crore at a semiconductor summit. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav stated that additional proposals worth around ₹5,800 crore have the potential to create 10,000 employment opportunities.

items.title: Bihar Attracts ₹1.21 Lakh Crore Investment Proposals Under Manufacturing Scheme
items.summary: Bihar has secured 1,091 investment proposals worth ₹1.21 lakh crore over the past 18 months. The state is actively implementing a national initiative to develop integrated manufacturing cities across 14 locations in India.

items.title: ITBP Overhauls Strategy Along China Border
items.summary: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) is revamping its training and combat deployment along the border with China. The paramilitary force was originally raised on October 24, 1962, following the Indo-China war.

items.title: Odisha Moves Supreme Court Over Kotia Border Dispute With Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Odisha has approached the Supreme Court against Andhra Pradesh regarding local election notifications in the disputed Kotia Gram Panchayat. Andhra Pradesh claims rights over 21 of the 28 villages in the area, where the apex court ordered status quo in 2006.

items.title: India and Azerbaijan Attempt Reset of Bilateral Relations
items.summary: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar met with the President and Foreign Minister of Azerbaijan to reset bilateral ties following previous strain. Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Bayramov highlighted trade, tourism, and energy cooperation after fruitful discussions.

items.title: IAEA Report Projects Global Nuclear Power Could More Than Triple by 2060
items.summary: According to the IAEA's annual report, global nuclear power capacity could more than triple by 2060. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi stated that this growth will be driven by electrification, AI-powered data centres, and technology companies seeking reliable, carbon-free power.

items.title: French and British Air Forces Stage Joint Nuclear Strike Simulation Exercise 'Rummy'
items.summary: The French and British air forces conducted their first joint nuclear strike simulation, codenamed 'Rummy', over the Mediterranean Sea. The exercise featured RAF Typhoon fighter jets operating alongside French Rafale aircraft.

items.title: UN Loss and Damage Fund Secures $822.06 Million in Pledges for Vulnerable Nations
items.summary: The UN Loss and Damage Fund recorded pledges totaling $822.06 million from 27 countries, with $629.70 million in grant contributions, providing crucial financial assistance to countries like Nepal.

items.title: Nepal to Receive First-Ever UN Loss and Damage Fund Payout
items.summary: Nepal is set to receive $21.6 million from the United Nations' Loss and Damage Fund following devastating Bhotekoshi floods. This marks the first time the global climate fund has earmarked money for a specific country to cover climate-change-linked losses.

items.title: Government Modifies Periodic Labour Force Survey to Include Gig Economy
items.summary: The Periodic Labour Force Survey will be modified with additional questions to capture data on the gig economy and unpaid household workers. The step aims to measure labour underutilisation across the nation.

items.title: Mona Agarwal and Nishad Kumar Named India's Closing Flag-Bearers at Asian Para Games
items.summary: Mona Agarwal and Nishad Kumar have been named India's flag-bearers for the closing ceremony of the Asian Para Games. Both athletes secured two gold medals each during the event.

items.title: Thulasimathi Murugesan Wins Gold in Badminton at Asian Para Games
items.summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan combined with Manasi Joshi to win the gold medal in women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton at the Asian Para Games. She finished the day with three medals, having also won two silver medals earlier.

items.title: Physicist Ashoke Sen Receives 2026 Oskar Klein Medal
items.summary: Ashoke Sen has been named the recipient of the 2026 Oskar Klein Medal.

items.title: Bharat Biotech Slashes Malaria Vaccine Price in Pact with UNICEF and GAVI
items.summary: Bharat Biotech has reduced the price of its malaria vaccine under a GAVI-backed agreement with UNICEF.
